_about: Derived from CODE_MAP.md, not written by hand. Creative Contraptions
records its reading as prose -- each function named with its address
and the reasoning beside it -- so this is a second view of one reading.
**If the two disagree, CODE_MAP.md is right.**
Addresses are offsets from the start of the code segment, as that
document defines them. Only functions CODE_MAP.md actually names appear
here; nothing was named from outside, because a second opinion grafted
on would drift from the first and nobody would know which was which.
`why` is the sentence each name appears in. Where the map marks a claim
as `dugaan` -- a guess -- the word is carried through rather than
That project's own verification is stronger than a symbol file: its
reconstructed C compiles to an .EXE identical to the original byte for
byte, so a wrong reading would fail to match rather than merely read
